snippet.title: Plura Ingenia: Patient 16 - Demo Story Trailer - Psychological Horror Game
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4335990/Plura_Ingenia_Patient_16/?beta=0

I am proud to announce that the playable demo for Plura Ingenia: Patient 16 will be available on March 17, 2026.

Plura Ingenia: Patient 16 is a first-person psychological horror game in which the player’s personality directly shapes the experience. Through an evolving evaluation system, choices and behavioral responses influence hallucinations, events, and encounters, ensuring that no two playthroughs unfold exactly the same way.

Alongside this announcement, Oblique Interactive is also unveiling the first official Story & Gameplay Trailer, offering a deeper look into the unsettling hospital setting and the adaptive psychological systems at the core of the experience.

The demo will be available on Steam.

For additional information, interview requests, or press access:
oblinteractive@gmail.com

Press Kit: https://impress.games/press-kit/oblique-interactive/plura-ingenia-patient-16

Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4335990/Plura_Ingenia_Patient_16/?beta=0

Join The Discord: https://discord.com/invite/KGJ5c2YJX6 

Discover the mysteries surrounding the medical facility operated by Plura Ingenia, a corporation that claims to make humans “better”.
